prompts.title: Introduce Yourself
prompts.description: Tell us about yourself in simple sentences
prompts.questionText: Please introduce yourself. What is your name? Where are you from? What do you do?

pronunciation.description: Clear pronunciation of basic words and simple sentences

fluency.description: Ability to speak with minimal pauses in simple responses

vocabulary.description: Use of basic everyday vocabulary appropriately

grammar.description: Simple present tense and basic sentence structures

prompts.title: Your Daily Routine
prompts.description: Describe what you do every day
prompts.questionText: What do you do every day? Tell me about your typical morning or evening routine.

pronunciation.description: Clear pronunciation of daily activity verbs

vocabulary.description: Basic verbs related to daily activities

grammar.description: Simple present tense for habitual actions

prompts.title: Describe Your Family
prompts.description: Talk about your family members
prompts.questionText: Tell me about your family. Who are the members of your family? What do they do?

vocabulary.description: Family member names and basic occupations

grammar.description: Subject-verb agreement in simple sentences

prompts.title: Your Favorite Food
prompts.description: Talk about what you like to eat
prompts.questionText: What is your favorite food? Why do you like it? When do you eat it?

vocabulary.description: Basic food vocabulary and simple adjectives

grammar.description: Simple present for preferences (I like, I eat)

prompts.title: Weekend Activities
prompts.description: Describe what you do on weekends
prompts.questionText: What do you usually do on weekends? Describe your last weekend activities.

fluency.description: Coherent description of past and habitual activities

grammar.description: Mix of simple present and past tense

prompts.title: Your Home or Neighborhood
prompts.description: Describe where you live
prompts.questionText: Describe your home or neighborhood. What do you like about it? What facilities are nearby?

grammar.description: There is/are, prepositions of place

prompts.title: A Memorable Day
prompts.description: Tell a story about a special day
prompts.questionText: Tell me about a memorable day in your life. What happened? Why was it special?

vocabulary.description: Past tense verbs and time expressions

grammar.description: Past simple tense for storytelling

prompts.title: Your Hobbies
prompts.description: Talk about activities you enjoy
prompts.questionText: What are your hobbies? How often do you do them? Why do you enjoy them?

grammar.description: Frequency adverbs and expressing likes

prompts.title: Shopping Experience
prompts.description: Describe a recent shopping trip
prompts.questionText: Tell me about the last time you went shopping. What did you buy? Where did you go?

grammar.description: Past simple for completed actions

prompts.title: Technology in Daily Life
prompts.description: Discuss how technology affects your life
prompts.questionText: How does technology affect your daily life? What are the advantages and disadvantages?

grammar.description: Complex sentences with connectors (because, although, however)

prompts.title: A Travel Experience
prompts.description: Describe a trip you took
prompts.questionText: Tell me about a trip you took. Where did you go? What did you do? What was your favorite part?

grammar.description: Past tenses (simple and continuous) and sequence markers

prompts.title: Healthy Lifestyle
prompts.description: Express your views on staying healthy
prompts.questionText: What does it mean to live a healthy lifestyle? What do you do to stay healthy? What advice would you give others?

fluency.description: Expressing opinions and giving advice smoothly

grammar.description: Modal verbs (should, could, might) and conditionals

prompts.title: Your Dream Job
prompts.description: Describe your ideal career
prompts.questionText: What is your dream job? What qualities and skills are needed? Why does it interest you?

grammar.description: Would/could for hypotheticals, present perfect

prompts.title: Social Media Impact
prompts.description: Discuss the effects of social media
prompts.questionText: How has social media changed the way people communicate? What are the positive and negative effects?

grammar.description: Present perfect, comparatives, and complex sentences

prompts.title: An Important Decision
prompts.description: Share a significant choice you made
prompts.questionText: Tell me about an important decision you had to make. What was the situation? What did you decide? How did it turn out?

fluency.description: Coherent narrative with cause and effect

grammar.description: Past tenses, conditionals, and result clauses

prompts.title: Environmental Challenges
prompts.description: Discuss environmental issues and solutions
prompts.questionText: What are the most pressing environmental challenges today? What can individuals and governments do to address them?

grammar.description: Passive voice, conditionals, and complex structures

prompts.title: Cultural Differences
prompts.description: Compare cultures and customs
prompts.questionText: Compare your culture with another culture you know about. What are the main differences in customs, values, or social norms?

grammar.description: Comparative structures and cultural present tense

prompts.title: The Future of Work
prompts.description: Predict changes in employment
prompts.questionText: How do you think the nature of work will change in the next 20 years? What skills will be most important? How should education adapt?

grammar.description: Future forms, conditionals, and modal verbs for speculation

prompts.title: A Learning Experience
prompts.description: Reflect on something that taught you a lesson
prompts.questionText: Describe a challenging experience that taught you an important lesson. What happened? What did you learn? How has it influenced you since?

fluency.description: Coherent narrative with reflection and analysis

grammar.description: Past perfect, present perfect, and result clauses

prompts.title: Education System Reform
prompts.description: Critique and propose improvements to education
prompts.questionText: What do you think are the strengths and weaknesses of modern education systems? What changes would you recommend?

grammar.description: Conditionals, passive voice, and evaluative language

prompts.title: Personal Achievement
prompts.description: Describe something you're proud of accomplishing
prompts.questionText: Tell me about an achievement you're particularly proud of. What did you do? What obstacles did you overcome? What made it meaningful?

grammar.description: Mixed past tenses and participial phrases
